purpose: M-8: compute the equilibrium for one finite instance rather than only certifying that one exists.

provenance.split: EMBER's released temporal split (train 2018-01..10, test 2018-11..12), used as shipped
provenance.train_subsample_reason: matched to E1's BODMAS training size so the corpus is the only variable between the two runs
provenance.test_subsample_reason: stratified, to bound resident memory; preserves the benign/malware ratio and therefore the alert population
